newsitem.title: ITALY: Prodi says Italy wants to be in first wave of EMU.
newsitem.headline: Prodi says Italy wants to be in first wave of EMU.

text.p: Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi said on Friday Italy wants to be in the first group of countries forming Europe's single currency.
"We want to enter in Europe with the first group of countries as protagonists, not just because our accounts are in order," Prodi told reporters in this north eastern town.
"Entering Europe is not just as matter of mathematics," he said.
Prodi has repeatedly said he wants Italy to be in the first wave of EMU and has said he will resign if it fails to get there.

However speculation has been rife this week that France and Germany are cooking up a deal to freeze Italy and Spain out of EMU's launch, despite denials from Bonn and Paris that any secret deals are in the offing.
France also issued a strong denial on Friday of reports that President Jacques Chirac had recently told German Chancellor Helmut Kohl he had withdrawn support for Italy's drive to join EMU.
